text:
olivia: Heads-up 1: we need a compact pilot gating checklist for Optimize (batching, caching, quant recs, eval alerts). Want something customers can read and sign off quickly.

raj: +1. Suggest a short "musts" and "nice-to-haves" list. Musts are non-negotiable for pilot safety.

olivia: OK draft musts:
- 72h baseline telemetry captured (tokens, p50/p95, cost)
- seeded eval set (>= 50 prompts) with automated daily scorecard
- canary plan: pct, duration, automatic revert triggers
- rollback path documented and tested

taylor: Nice-to-haves:
- console preview with expected cost delta and risk tags
- confidence estimate for each recommendation
- knob ordering suggestion + short rationale

sam: For metrics/thresholds propose: 
- cost: >= 10% median token-cost reduction over 24h sample
- perf: p95 not worse than +12% of baseline (absolute target if SLA exists)
- quality: eval pass-rate drop <= 2% or absolute metric within agreed band

raj: Alerts: separate noisy vs action alerts. Noisy alerts should be aggregated (daily digest). Action alerts (page) only on sustained quality loss or major perf regression.

olivia: Canary rules I want in PR:
- default canary: 5% traffic, min 20m, require p95 check at end
- auto-revert if p95 > baseline * 1.2 for 10m or eval pass-rate drops > 1.5% in 1h
- manual abort button in Console that halts rollout and schedules revert

taylor: UX: in preview modal show three things: expected delta (cost/latency), risk level (low/med/high), confidence (N samples). Also include short bullet "why recommended".

sam: Implementation notes: emit metrics to telemetry backend with clear labels. Example names:
- inf.optimize.apply (labels: model, knob, quant_level, pilot_id)
- inf.optimize.eval_violation (labels: check, severity, pilot_id)

raj: We'll also need a minimal CLI for pilots so they can run a local preview against a sample window. Example: 
```
ri optimize preview --pilot pilot123 --window 4h
```
It should print recommendations and estimated uplift range.

olivia: Security/legal: private pilots require KMS integration and a documented data retention policy. Add a line in gating: "KMS key assigned or data never leaves VPC" for private deploys.

sam: Rollback runbook items:
- how to revert model/knob changes in Console and API
- who to page for manual assistance (oncall/team contacts)
- how to validate revert success (smoke script)

raj: Pilot acceptance matrix suggestion (simple):
1) PASS if cost improvement >=10% AND quality within threshold AND p95 within SLA.
2) MINOR PASS if cost 5-10% but requires manual review.
3) FAIL if quality regression >2% or p95 regression >15%.

olivia: Add deploy constraints: quantization recommendations should be staged: suggest 8-bit first, then 4-bit behind an opt-in flag. For 4-bit require explicit customer consent and additional eval window (24h).

taylor: Sample YAML we'll show in pilot brief (compact, differs from earlier drafts):
```yaml
pilot:
  id: pilot-acme-01
  knobs:
    batching: {mode: adaptive, max_batch_tokens: 4096}
    prefix_cache: {enabled: true, ttl: 10m}
    quant_recommendation: {suggest: true, prefer: [8, 4], require_consent: true}
  eval:
    seed_set: acme_pilot_v1
    pass_rate_tolerance: 0.02
  canary:
    pct: 5
    min_duration: 20m
    revert_on: {p95_mult: 1.2, eval_drop_pct: 1.5}
```

sam: Ops request: instrument a dry-run mode that applies recommendations to metrics only (no model changes) so customers can preview impact without risk.

raj: Good point. Dry-run should be default for first 24h for any new pilot unless customer opts into live apply.

olivia: Timeline proposal (compact):
- Day 0-4: finalize heuristics, build eval harness and sample seed sets
- Day 5-10: metrics wiring + preview CLI + console modal
- Day 11-14: internal canary and runbook verification
- Week 3: onboard first pilot customers

taylor: Resource ask: 2 engs frontend/backend for 3 weeks, 1 reliability engineer 1 week for canary automation, 1 PM to coordinate pilots.

ops-bot: canary-checklist created: pilot-acme-01 -> requires KMS, dry-run enabled by default.

olivia: Great. I'll convert this thread into a short gating doc + a PR checklist and share a link in #pilot-onboarding. Flag anything missing now.

raj: Maybe add a simple FAQ section for customers about quant tradeoffs and expected latency patterns.

olivia: Will do. Thanks everyone.
